comments.value: Definitely a huge problem.  Happening to myself and everyone I spoke to tonight.

It sometimes works and sometimes does not, it feels like it tries to load an old "state". 

Like when I set something to be enabled, it will be off when I rejoin but the next time it *might* be enabled, even though if I turned it off in between.

I thought I noticed something weird last night... I toggled my avatars hoodie on before switching worlds but then I realized it was no longer on upon entering new world. Thought I just didn't actually toggle it.
Noticed it last night on a new Avi I uploaded after the update. Annoys me to keep having to change the outfit back.
Yes!! one of my main avatars is stuck tiny and unusable! it’s driving me crazy
How is this complete? This shit is still happening or do I need to reupload the avatar?

details:
On the current build, loading avatars when travelling to another world or loading from the menu doesn't seems to behave completely as intended.

From what I observed, it is probably using the last saved state before the update and not saving new changes.

After you use "reset avatar", however, it will always load the defaults even if you make new changes, still not saving said changes.

(I only tested in Desktop since I don't own any VR headset)
title: Avatar parametters not saved correctly
